description: Banking - Expense Tracking & Analysis: Track expenses, analyze spending patterns, import transactions via CSV, categorize manually and automatically, detect recurring transactions, and view analytics with charts.

userStories.title: Create BankTransaction model and database schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store bank transactions with all required fields so they persist and can be queried efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: Create BankTransaction model with fields: date (date), description (string), value (decimal), row_hash (string, unique index), category_id (foreign key, nullable), user_id (foreign key)
Add row_hash unique index scoped to user for deduplication
Add indexes on date, category_id, and user_id for query performance
Generate and run migration successfully
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Create Category model
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store categories that can be assigned to transactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Category model with fields: name (string), color (string for hex color), user_id (foreign key)
Add unique index on name scoped to user
Seed default categories: Groceries, Fuel, Subscriptions, Dining, Transport, Shopping, Bills, Entertainment, Health, Other
Generate and run migration successfully
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Create CategoryPattern model for auto-categorization
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store patterns that automatically assign categories based on transaction descriptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create CategoryPattern model with fields: pattern (string), category_id (foreign key), user_id (foreign key)
Pattern field stores case-insensitive substring to match against descriptions
Add unique index on pattern scoped to user
Generate and run migration successfully
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Build CSV import service with background processing
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that processes CSV files in the background and imports transactions without duplicates.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Banking::ImportService that accepts a CSV file and user
Parse CSV with headers: Date, Description, Value
Handle date format DD-MM-YYYY
Handle value format with comma as decimal separator (e.g., 9,109.70 or -24.28)
Generate row_hash as SHA256 of normalized date|description|value string
Skip rows where row_hash already exists for user
Create Banking::ImportJob that calls the service (Solid Queue)
Return import results: total rows, imported count, skipped count (duplicates)
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Apply automatic categorization on import
userStories.description: As a developer, I need transactions to be automatically categorized during import based on existing patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: During import, match each transaction description against user's CategoryPatterns
If pattern matches (case-insensitive substring), assign that category
First matching pattern wins (ordered by pattern length, longest first)
Leave category as null if no pattern matches
Typecheck/lint passes
